P.name: Daredevil Impulse
P.title: Template:Data Samira/Daredevil Impulse
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Daredevil Impulse|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Samira |skill = I |icon = Samira Inferno Trigger 2.png |icon2 = Samira Style.gif |icon3 = Daredevil Impulse.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Samira}} {{tip|basic attacks}} and damaging {{tip|abilities}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} that are unique from the previous hit generate a ''Style'' {{tip|stack}}, up to 6. |blurb2 = '''Samira''' can attack {{tip|immobilized}} enemies to rapidly fire a barrage of bolts at them. If she is slightly outside of her {{sti|attack range}}, she will also {{tip|dash}} into it, then fire. Additionally, attacking {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} that are {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} will {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} again briefly.
This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Samira's''' sword deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to enemies based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}. She uses her sword when she casts certain abilities or attacks enemies within {{tip|er|melee range}}. |blurb4 = {{sbc|Innate - Style:}} Each stack grants {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and an increasing grade [[File:Samira_Style.gif|Samira's Style grades|20px|link=]] from E to S. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Samira's''' damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} against at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Style'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 6 times. |description2 = {{sbc|Style:}} For each stack, '''Samira''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|2.75 to 3.5 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pp|16.5 to 21 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}}|ms}}. At maximum stacks, '''Samira''' can cast ''{{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}}''. |description3 = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Samira's''' basic attacks against targets within {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 200 units of her use her blade, becoming {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}. Blade attacks, ''{{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}}'', ''{{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}}'', and the slash and explosives of ''{{ai|Flair|Samira}}'' deal {{as|{{pp|2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ {{pp|3.5 + (10.5-3.5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD)}} '''bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 by 5|0 to 100 by 5|formula=1% for every 1% missing health|key=%|key1=%|label1=target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}, up to {{as|{{pp|(2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1))*2 for 20}} {{as|(+ {{pp|(3.5 + (10.5-3.5)/17*(x-1))*2 for 20|key=%}} AD)}}|magic damage}}. |description4 = '''Samira's''' basic attack against an {{tip|immobilized}} target is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and fire {{tt|6 bolts over {{fd|0.5}} seconds|First bolt at the time of cast then once every 0.1 seconds thereafter.}}, each dealing {{as|17% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applying}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}. If the target is a {{tip|monster}} or is {{tip|airborne}}, the attack also {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. |description5 = The empowered attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Samira's''' basic attack timer, is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once, and cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds. |description6 = If the target is further away from '''Samira's''' {{sti|attack range}}, initiating an attack against the immobilized target while within valid range of them will first cause her to {{tip|dash}} toward them up to her {{sti|attack range}}, then automatically cast the bolts. |target range = {{tip|er|icononly=true}} {{pp|650 to 950|1;4;8;12;16|formula=650 + 75 every 4 levels, capped at 950. Maximum range to initiate the empowered attack's dash from.}} |speed = {{dv|{{tt|2050|Empowered attack dash speed}}|{{tt|2800|Empowered attack bolt missiles speed}}}} |ontargetcdstatic= {{tt|10|Empowered attack/dash lockout (also see notes)}} |targeting = Passive |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spellshield = special |spelleffects = special |grounded = special |knockdown = true |parry = true |projectile = special |callforhelp = |notes = * The ''Style'' stack count is represented by the grades [[File:Samira Rank E.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank D.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank C.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank B.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank A.png|20px|border|link=]] [[File:Samira Rank S.png|20px|border|link=]] to the left of '''Samira's''' [[health bar]], visible to the player only, as well as a stack counter under the [[health bar]], visible to all players. No grade is represented by [[File:Samira Inferno Trigger 2.png|20px|border|link=]] just on {{ais|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} ability icon. * Abilities blocked by {{tip|spell shield|spell shields}} will still grant '''Samira''' ''Style'' stacks. * ''Style'' stacks can be generated via {{tip|clones}}. * Gun and blade attacks do not count as different for the purposes of stacking ''Style''. * Basic attacks using the blade are still classified as {{tip|ranged}}. * The blade attack's range condition is unaffected by {{as|{{sti|attack range}}}} modifiers (e.g. {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}). ** Its attack range is calculated edge-to-edge, as normal (i.e., {{tip|size}} modifiers on '''Samira''' or her target can still increase the effective distance as basic attack range is added onto unit size). * The blade attack bonus deals {{tip|default damage}}. * The blade attack bonus does not apply against {{tip|structures}}. * The blade attack bonus applies after the primary damage of the attack and is '''not''' an {{tip|on-hit}} effect. * The empowered attack's bolts deal: ** {{tip|Basic damage}} for the first bolt, as a basic attack would. ** {{tip|Default damage}} for all subsequent bolts. * Each bolt from the empowered attack rolls for a {{tip|critical strike}} separately. * The empowered attack will trigger on {{tip|immobilize|immobilizes}} from any source. ** It specifically cannot trigger against enemies affected by {{uis|Blast Cone}} displacement triggered by anyone.{{bug|2}} * The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immune}} and {{tip|displacement immune}} targets. * {{cai|Riposte|Fiora}} can resist the knock up from ''Daredevil Impulse'', but the ability will not trigger its on-{{tip|immobilize|immobilization}} empowerment condition from the attack alone.{{bug|2}} * '''Samira''' may dash and have her dash to an {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} target canceled an indefinite number of times, so long as the empowered attack has not triggered. When the empowered attack begins, ''Daredevil Impulse's'' cooldown is applied on the target which also prevents her from initiating the dash and the attack again on them for the duration. * The on-target cooldown will start even if the empowered attack is parried. * While {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, '''Samira''' cannot {{tip|dash}} into range to use the empowered attack. She can only use it if her target is within her {{sti|attack range}} while under this condition. * The empowered attack will not apply the knock up against {{tip|suspension|suspended}} enemies. * The empowered attack will only apply the knock up if the target is still {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|airborne}} upon being hit. It will not apply if they are no longer disabled when hit. * The empowered attack cannot be used against a target with a {{tip|spell shield}}. * The application of the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} effect can occur on any of the bolts of the empowered attack if it had not already occurred on the first. ** A missile that is parried by {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}} or is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or misses while '''Samira''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}} '''cannot''' apply the knock up in any way. * The empowered attack's speed is unaffected by {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}} modifiers. * If '''Samira''' is outside maximum initiation range for the dash when targeting an immobilized target, the player must input a new Attack order on the target upon entering initiation range in order to actually initiate the dash. ** However if '''Samira''' enters the bolts' cast range via her movement while the target is still immobilized without issuing any other commands, the empowered attack will cast without requiring a new order (without the dash). * The empowered attack removes any forced movement affecting the target once its knock up ends.{{bug|2}} ** {{pending for test}} Does this also happen if it's {{tip|cleanse|cleansed}}. |tips = * '''Samira''' can target enemies affected by {{uis|Dragon}} or {{uis|Baron Nashor}} {{tip|airborne|displacing}} attacks and abilities with the empowered attack/dash, allowing for an unexpected initiation or quick [[Terminology#Poke|poke]]. }}

W.name: Blade Whirl
W.title: Template:Data Samira/Blade Whirl
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Blade Whirl|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Samira
|skill        = W
|icon         = Blade Whirl.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Samira}} briefly spins her blade twice, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies each time. During this time, she destroys all incoming enemy {{tip|projectile|projectiles}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' spins her blade over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, destroying all hostile non-{{tip|turret}} {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} within the area for the duration.
|description2 = '''Samira''' slashes twice during ''Blade Whirl'', each one dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies. The first slash occurs immediately and the second one occurs after the duration.
|leveling2    = {{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|20 to 80}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*2 to 80*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description3 = '''''Samira''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Flair|Samira}} during Blade Whirl. Casting {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} will end Blade Whirl early.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|30 to 22}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 60
|costtype     = Mana
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 325
|width        = 
|cast time    = {{fd|0.1}}
|speed        = 
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = aoe
|projectile   = 
|callforhelp  = 
|notes        = 
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage from one slash.
* While the ability has a cast time - the cast time has no effect on the ability's usability. All effects begin immediately and '''Samira''' can move throughout. 
* Both slashes count as the same ability for stacking {{ai|Daredevil Impulse|Samira|Style}}.
* The effect ending early includes the second slash not being performed, if applicable.  
* Entering {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} will also end ''Blade Whirl'' early.
** Other item actives and channeling {{si|Teleport}} or {{si|Recall}} will ''not'' end the effect early.
* '''Samira''' can ignore the lockout for {{ai|Flair|Samira}} and basic attacks if she uses {{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}} and queues up {{ai|Flair|Samira}} and/or a basic attack at the start of it.{{bug}}
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Samira_Original_W_5.ogg}} ''"Don't think so."''
|tips =
* ''{{ai|Flair|Samira}}'' cannot be directly cast during this ability, but can still occur through the ''{{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}}'' + ''{{ai|Flair|Samira}}'' interaction.
}}

E.name: Wild Rush
E.title: Template:Data Samira/Wild Rush
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Wild Rush|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Samira
|skill        = E
|icon         = Wild Rush.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Samira}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} at the target enemy or enemy structure, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through. She also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a short time.
|blurb2       = Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} {{sti|cdr|resets}} ''Wild Rush's'' cooldown.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy or enemy {{tip|turret|structure}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through. She also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
|leveling    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 90}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
|description2 = Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them resets ''Wild Rush's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
|description3 = ''{{ai|Flair|Samira}} and {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} can be cast during the dash. Casting {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} will buffer it to cast at the end of the dash.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|20 to 12}}
|cost         = 40
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|600|Cast range}} 
|range        = {{dv|{{tt|650|Fixed dash distance}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|800|Dash hitbox length}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|-150|Dash hitbox behind Samira}}}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 300
|cast time    = none
|speed        = 1600
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = aoe
|grounded     = true
|knockdown    = true
|callforhelp  = true
|notes        = 
* '''Samira''' gains the attack speed buff at the start of the dash.
* ''Wild Rush'' does not deal its damage to turrets.
* ''Wild Rush'' prioritizes targeting champions over turrets.
* {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} will be buffered to cast at the end of the dash if {{ai|Flair|Samira}} was cast during the dash.
* Casting {{si|Flash}} during ''Wild Rush'' will interrupt the dash but deal damage to nearby enemies at the location.
** If {{ai|Flair|Samira}} was cast during this time, an explosive will also be placed at that location.
* ''Wild Rush'' will also reset if '''Samira''' kills or gets assist credit on a {{tip|clone}} that dies (to hostiles).{{bug|2}}
}}

R.name: Inferno Trigger
R.title: Template:Data Samira/Inferno Trigger
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Inferno Trigger|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Samira
|skill        = R
|icon         = Samira Inferno Trigger.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Samira}} unleashes a torrent of shots, reducing her {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} and rapidly firing shots that deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
|blurb3      = Each shot can {{tip|critically strike}} and {{tip|applies lifesteal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
|blurb4      = ''Inferno Trigger'' costs ''{{ai|Daredevil Impulse|Samira|6 Style|image= Samira Rank S.png}}'' stacks.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' unleashes a torrent of shots for {{rutngt|2.25}}, '''reducing''' her {{as|movement speed}} by {{as|30%|ms}} and rapidly shooting at  nearby enemies over {{rutngt|2}} at sporadic times in {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second intervals|on average; total of 5 intervals of 0.231 and 5 of 0.198 seconds}} each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each shot, reduced by 75% against {{tip|minions}}. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage Per Shot|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 30% AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*10 to 60*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*10}}% AD)}}}}
{{st|Minion Damage Per Shot|{{ap|20*0.25 to 60*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.25}}% AD)}}|Total Minion Damage|{{ap|20*0.25*10 to 60*0.25*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.25*10}}% AD)}}}}
|description2 = ''A nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy is required to cast this ability, and targets do not have to be visible to be shot at. {{ai|Daredevil Impulse|Samira|Style|image= Samira Rank S.png}} stacks are consumed at the end of the effect.''
|description3 = '''''Samira''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Flair|Samira}} and {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} during Inferno Trigger, but she can still move. Inferno Trigger will end prematurely if '''Samira''' is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} as well as {{tip|disarm}}. Inferno Trigger cannot be cast while '''Samira''' is {{tip|disarm|disarmed}}.''
|static       = 5
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 6 Style
|costtype     = 
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 600
|cast time    = none
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Proximity
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = aoedot
|projectile   = true
|callforhelp  = true
|silence      = true
|notes        = 
* '''Samira's''' facing direction remains as it had been or, if she is moving, towards that direction during ''Inferno Trigger''.
* The {{as|{{sti|movement speed}}}} reduction stacks additively with other {{as|movement speed}} bonuses. 
** It is a negative bonus, not a {{tip|slow}}, and is thus not reduced by {{tip|slow resist}}.
* ''Inferno Trigger's'' area of effect is fixed around '''Samira'''.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage of one shot.
* ''Inferno Trigger'' will not end if there are no enemies that remain in range.
* The bottom of the [[Summoner|player's]] screen will have a fiery visual effect while '''Samira''' is at ''S'' rank and ''Inferno Trigger'' has at least one rank.
* Since {{ais|R|Samira}} cooldown is static, {{ri|Ultimate Hunter}} will be swapped with {{ri|Treasure Hunter}} for '''Samira''' at the start of the game.
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Samira_Original_R_1.ogg}} ''"Showtime!"''
}}
